change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, BRS Analytical Services, LLC는 무균 OTC 의약품 제조구역의 벽 틈·차압관리·환경모니터링이 부적절하고, 작업자 행동·매체충전·멸균검증·연기시험도 무균공정 위험을 통제하지 못했다. 품질부서는 부적합 조건에서 제조된 제품의 유통을 허용했고, FDA 권고 후 전 로트 자진회수가 진행됐다. 생산은 시설·설비·무균공정을 재정비하고 QA는 배치출하 전 환경자료와 검증상태를 승인해야 한다.

impact_summary.value: FDA는 무균 제조시설의 부적절한 설계와 환경 모니터링·무균 공정·품질관리 미흡으로 제품 무균성 보장이 훼손되고 환자 위험이 발생할 수 있다고 설명합니다. 제품은 CGMP 위반으로 부정 adulterated 상태이며, 미해결 위반은 규제·법적 조치, 수출증명서 보류 또는 신규 신청 승인 보류로 이어질 수 있습니다.

evidence.quote: The lack of both physical and aerodynamic segregation in your aseptic processing facility design posed an unacceptable risk to product sterility. The ISO 5 area is critical because sterile drug products are exposed and are therefore vulnerable to contamination.

Failure to promptly and adequately address this matter may result in regulatory or legal action without further notice including, without limitation, seizure and injunction. Unresolved violations may also prevent other Federal agencies from awarding contracts. Failure to address violations may also cause FDA to withhold issuance of Export Certificates.

affected_work.value: BRS Analytical Services의 미국 시장용 무균 OTC 의약품 제조·가공·포장·보관, 무균 충전 및 환경·인력 모니터링, 품질관리단위의 CGMP 감독이 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) inspected your drug manufacturing facility and contract testing laboratory, BRS Analytical Services, LLC, FEI 3023604380, at 11697 Lakeside Crossing Court, St. Louis, from March 10 to 26, 2025.
Your ISO 5 area used for aseptic compounding and filling sterile over-the-counter (OTC) (b)(4) drug products was fundamentally unsuitable for its intended use.

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반사항을 신속히 시정하고 재발 방지 조치를 하며, 서신 수령 후 15 근무일 이내에 취한 조치와 재발 방지 내용을 서면으로 회신하라고 요구합니다. 기한 내 시정조치를 완료할 수 없다면 지연 사유와 완료 일정을 밝히라고 합니다. 제조 재개를 계획하면 FDA에 통지하고 시정·예방조치 완료를 보여주는 시정 내역 요약을 제공해야 하며, 재개 시에는 적격 컨설턴트의 평가 및 CAPA 완료·효과 평가를 권고합니다.

evidence.quote: After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence. In response to this letter, you may provide additional information for our consideration as we continue to assess your activities and practices. If you cannot complete corrective actions within 15 working days, state your reasons for delay and your schedule for completion.

Notify this office if you intend to resume your drug manufacturing operations at this site or in another location. You are responsible for resolving all deficiencies and systemic flaws to ensure that your firm is capable of ongoing CGMP compliance. In your notification to the Agency, provide a summary of your remediations to demonstrate that you have appropriately completed all corrective actions and preventive actions (CAPA).

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, you should engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to evaluate your operations and to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements if your firm intends to resume manufacturing drugs for the U.S. market.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
